descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S13 Hospital: an unfinished Add Point draft when Save Note is tapped

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U1 The panel is physician-authored only (PR #49): nothing is generated from the pre-round note, and saving a pre-round note on a patient with no points leaves the Important Points panel empty. … (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital patient with two saved points

When Press Add Point, type a point but do not press Save Point; type a note and Save Note; reopen

Then The two saved points are unchanged; the draft text is not lost and not merged into another card

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Checkpoint, judged now: Existing A, Existing B and the draft text are all shown after Save Note (the draft is not lost). backendChecks, judged once read (oracleRules 1): A and B unchanged; the draft text kept, as a card or as the draft. Recorded for Q4: whether Save Note turned the draft into a card

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
